highlights.summary: Seasonal smog is a major public health problem in Thailand. Long-delayed legislation aims to stop air pollution before it starts, but enforcement could present a problem.

highlights.headline: EU, Mexico sign expanded trade deal

items.title: At least 82 killed in Chinese coal mine explosion
items.description: The blast in Shanxi province constitutes the country's worst mining disaster in 16 years.

items.title: China: Dozens dead in coal mine blast — state media
items.description: An explosion in a coal mine in northern China has killed at least 82 people, with some still unaccounted for, state media say. President Xi Jinping has demanded an "all-out" effort to search for and rescue those missing.
